# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.1.0   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.1.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

To report a vulnerability, please report it [here](https://github.com/Kjur0/bun-logger/security/advisories/new) on the GitHub repository.

If the vulnerability is found in a dependency, please report it to the maintainers of that dependency.

## Security Updates

Security updates will be released as soon as possible after a vulnerability is reported and fixed. The version number will be incremented according to semantic
versioning principles, with a patch release for bug fixes and a minor release for new features or breaking changes.

A security advisory will be published on GitHub for each vulnerability, including details about the vulnerability, the affected versions, and the fixed version.
